reason: A read-only file utility that computes and verifies SHA-256 or SHA-512 checksums through the active Harness filesystem provider without writing files or accessing the network.

summaries.zh: 通过当前 Harness 文件系统读取单个文件并计算或验证 SHA-256、SHA-512 校验和的只读工具。
summaries.en: A read-only utility that computes or verifies SHA-256 and SHA-512 checksums for a single file through the active Harness filesystem provider.

capabilities: Reads one regular file through the active Harness filesystem provider
Compares a computed digest with an expected hexadecimal digest
Returns file path, digest, byte count, and verification status
